items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1970-02-14

ctx.x: Well, now, isn't it, isn't it the fact that George replaced, um, Edmund Hall when Edmund Hall left?

In Buddy band? Mm-hmm. Yeah, George played a while with Buddy band, see, but I was, I had left Buddy band, then I was working with Chris Kelly band, Ed Rene band, like I told you, and Jack Carey's band, you know? Yes. But George, he was still running around there with Buddy.

items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: Yes, I worked with Chris a long time. Yes, I worked with Chris Kelly a long time.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's right. A couple of other questions I had. Did you play with Chris Kelly?
Yes, I worked with Chris a long time. Yes, I worked with Chris Kelly a long time. I worked with all them big star trumpet players around here, all of them. All of them, yes sir.
Who was your favorite trumpet player, if you had to pick one to hear again? Today? Yeah. Who would you rather hear?
